fields.description: Issue dated Saturday, August 20, 1927 (Vol. 4, No. 30), edited by Wen R. Phillips. Covers Miami civic and political affairs including discussion of a new city manager and city commission dynamics; criticism of justice-of-the-peace practices and court delays; debate over a proposed Miami auditorium and suggested Florida East Coast Railway support; commentary on municipal finance and banks imposing service charges on small checking accounts; public works and infrastructure topics such as Biscayne Boulevard light standards, Bayfront Park improvements, Miami River cleanup, and road projects (Dixie Highway and Tamiami Trail). Includes columns and features ("Miamigrams," "Cap's Column," "Little Geraldine"), a satirical piece on Shrine convention concessions, notices and advertisements, and coverage of local events including a "Miss Florida" bathing beauty revue and Coral Gables building activity.
